subject: ela
skillName: Author's point of view and rhetoric
intro: Author's point of view and opposing views.

items.prompt:
The reason an author writes a text is the:
A) purpose
B) page count
C) title font

An opposing viewpoint the author addresses is a:
A) counterclaim
B) conclusion
C) heading

Acknowledging opposing evidence makes an author seem more:
A) credible and fair
B) confused
C) biased

Read.

'Critics call wind farms an eyesore. While their appearance is debatable, the clean energy they provide outweighs that concern.'

The author responds to the objection by:
A) ignoring it
B) acknowledging it, then rebutting it with a stronger point
C) agreeing with it fully
items.answer: B) acknowledging it, then rebutting it with a stronger point

solution.answer: B) acknowledging it, then rebutting it with a stronger point

items.prompt:
In that passage, the author's position is that wind farms are:
A) a bad idea
B) worthwhile
C) unimportant

steps: Benefits outweigh concerns. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Why ACKNOWLEDGE conflicting evidence instead of ignoring it?
A) it shows fairness and makes the argument stronger
B) it weakens the claim
C) it is never useful
items.answer: A) it shows fairness and makes the argument stronger

solution.answer: A) it shows fairness and makes the argument stronger

items.prompt:
An author writes, 'Some studies suggest the drug has side effects. These deserve study, but for most patients the benefits are far greater.' This BEST shows the author:
A) acknowledging conflicting evidence, then explaining why their position still holds
B) hiding the evidence
C) having no point of view
items.answer: A) acknowledging conflicting evidence, then explaining why their position still holds

solution.answer: A) acknowledging conflicting evidence, then explaining why their position still holds

items.prompt:
An author presents only the facts that favor their side and never mentions the opposing view. This argument is:
A) one-sided and less credible
B) perfectly balanced
C) objective

steps: No opposing view = weaker. Key is A.
